title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 1（2026-10-29）
summary: 目前約 500 分，目標 650。點選答案立即看對錯與解析，30 分鐘做完 18 題後，把分數回報到聊天室。

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 12 分鐘）

qs.stem: The new assembly line will be ------- by the end of next month.
qs.exp: 被動語態 will be + 過去分詞：生產線是「被完成」。complete 當形容詞語意是「完整的」，不合；completing 是主動進行；completion 是名詞，不能接在 be 後當動作。

qs.stem: Ms. Chen asked that all reports ------- before Friday.
qs.exp: ask / request / suggest that 後面用原形動詞（假設語氣），報告是「被提交」，所以用 be submitted。submit 是主動；submitting 不是完整動詞；are submitted 不符合原形規則。

qs.stem: Employees must wear safety goggles ------- operating the cutting machine.
qs.exp: while + V-ing（省略主詞的副詞子句）表示「在做……的時候」。during 是介系詞，後面接名詞（during the operation），不接 V-ing；since 是「自從 / 因為」；unless 是「除非」，語意不合。

qs.stem: The supplier offered a discount ------- we placed a large order.
qs.exp: 空格後是完整子句（we placed...），要用連接詞 because。because of 和 despite 是介系詞，只能接名詞；due 要寫成 due to，也是接名詞。

qs.stem: Please contact the maintenance team ------- the machine stops working.
qs.exp: 條件句：「如果」機器停止運作就聯絡維修。so（所以）、but（但是）、or（或者）都無法表達條件關係。

qs.stem: Our sales increased ------- after the new product was launched.
qs.exp: 修飾動詞 increased 要用副詞 significantly。significant 是形容詞，修飾名詞；significance 是名詞；signify 是動詞。TOEIC 常考：動詞後面修飾 → -ly 副詞。

qs.stem: Neither the manager nor the engineers ------- aware of the problem.
qs.exp: neither A nor B 的動詞跟 B（靠近動詞的那個）一致。B = the engineers（複數），所以用 were。was / is 是單數；being 不是完整動詞。

qs.stem: The conference room is ------- for meetings of up to twenty people.
qs.exp: be 動詞後面接形容詞當補語：be suitable for（適合……）。suitably 是副詞，不能單獨當補語；suit 是動詞 / 名詞；suiting 不合語意。

qs.stem: Mr. Lin has worked at the factory ------- 2019.
qs.exp: 現在完成式 + since + 時間點（2019）。for 接一段時間（for five years）；from 要搭配 to / until；at 用在時刻。
比較級 later 後接 than。then 是「然後 / 那時」，常被拼錯混淆；as 用在 as...as；that 不能接比較級。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 8 分鐘）
passage: From November 3 to November 5, the main parking lot will be closed for repairs. Staff are asked to park in the east lot on Harbor Road during this period. A free shuttle bus will run between the east lot and the main building every 15 minutes from 7:30 A.M. to 9:30 A.M. Please allow extra time for your morning commute. For questions, contact Facilities at extension 214.

qs.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?
opts: To announce a new shuttle route
To inform staff of a temporary closure
qs.exp: 主旨題看第一句：停車場 11/3 到 11/5 因維修「暫時關閉」。接駁車只是配套措施，不是主旨；文中沒有徵求志工或改變上班時間。

qs.stem: How often will the shuttle bus run?
qs.exp: 細節題：原文 every 15 minutes。小心不要被 7:30 到 9:30 這些數字干擾。

qs.stem: What are staff advised to do?
qs.exp: 換句話說題：allow extra time for your morning commute（通勤多留時間）= leave earlier than usual。214 是有問題才打；停車是在 east lot on Harbor Road，不是 main road。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 10 分鐘）
sections.tip: 按播放鍵聽題目和 A、B、C 三個回應，再點選答案。正式考試看不到文字，建議先不要打開文字稿。

qs.stem: When will the new machine be delivered?
qs.exp: When 問時間 → next Tuesday。Wh 疑問句不能用 Yes / No 回答，A 還重複 new 是陷阱；C 回答地點（Where）。

qs.stem: Who's in charge of the safety training?
qs.exp: Who 問人 → Ms. Wang。B 回答時間（When）；C 是在評論訓練，答非所問。

qs.stem: Would you like me to print the report for you?
qs.exp: Would you like me to...? 是提議幫忙，接受就說 That would be great。A 用 report 聯想到 page；C 用 print 聯想到 printer，都是相關字陷阱。
Why 問原因，回答可以直接講原因，不一定有 because。B 回答地點；C 是 Yes / No，不能回答 Why 問句。

qs.stem: Haven't you finished the drawings yet?
qs.exp: 否定疑問句問「還沒完成嗎？」→ 快好了。B 用 drawing 重複字陷阱；C 回答地點。
